title: Quickly Shattering Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flexitarian-friendly Syrian dish featuring herbal flavors and a miso marinade, served in a terracotta dish with a side of Turkish delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a terracotta dish and bake for 15 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the oven and sprinkle with sumac.
Serve the lamb kebabs with toasted pita bread, Turkish delight, and a side of mixed greens.
Garnish with additional sumac and lemon wedges, if desired.
